instruction: Open-choice CLI requirement: This environment provides three candidate engineering toolchains, including BIM-capable tools and a distractor tool. Choose an appropriate BIM-capable command-line or official automation workflow from these options to edit C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc and export the completed IFC4 deliverable as C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc. Do not directly create, rewrite, patch, copy, or post-process IFC outside the selected BIM toolchain. The current model is a compact single-room site office shell with a plain rectangular form and a simple entrance-facing facade. The contractor wants the room register cleaned up so the unassigned interior is treated as the print and copy point for daily site operations. Keep the exterior shell, slab, and main facade intact, and add only the BIM room information needed for operations to recognize the space as PRINT-COPY.
source: Open-choice BIM environment; evaluation checks IFC deliverable semantics rather than the selected tool.
